i.norm: Verifies that parsing an argument array where the first element is a concatenated short-option-plus-value token ("-s#") succeeds when "-s" is a known option that accepts an argument. The remaining nine array slots are null and must be tolerated without causing a NullPointerException or ParseException.
Register option "-s" as one that accepts an argument value
Build an args array where the first token combines the option flag and its value ("-s#" means: option "s" with value "#"), followed by nine null slots
